clauses.zh: 以靛蓝为主色，唯一醒目的橙红落在伞面补片。
clauses.en: Use indigo as the main color, with orange-red as the sole prominent accent at the umbrella patch.

clauses.zh: 将细节集中在指尖与相邻伞骨，外围保持疏朗。
clauses.en: Concentrate detail at the fingertips and nearby ribs and keep the surrounding area sparse.

clauses.zh: 用粗细分明的靛蓝线条与平面墨块塑形，米白纸面保留轻微纤维。
clauses.en: Build forms with indigo lines of distinct weights and flat ink shapes over lightly fibrous off-white paper.

clauses.zh: 以一位修伞师为主体，呈现一手稳住旧伞、另一手按实补片。
clauses.en: Feature an umbrella repairer, depicting one hand holding an old umbrella while the other presses down its patch.

clauses.zh: 场景为雨后的社区修伞铺，后景只交代必要内容。
clauses.en: Set the image in a neighborhood repair shop after rain, using only essential background detail.

clauses.zh: 让伞骨和人物的视线引向手指与补片接触处。
clauses.en: Use the umbrella ribs and the repairer's gaze to lead attention to the fingertips touching the patch.
